visible_comparison: The tall rectangular tower is at the left/back of the base, matching the drawing's isometric view.
Two lower rectangular steps descend toward the front/right, with widths 12 and 12 beyond the 20-wide tower, matching the top-view width chain 20-12-12.
The base block projects farther right than the lower step and has an exposed front ledge, as in the drawing.
A single round hole is visible on the front face, right of center, at the lower part of the base; its placement matches the front-view circle (16 from the right edge, 16 above the base bottom).
No visible feature mismatch or reflection was found; the screen isometry is a rotation of the drawing's isometric, not a mirrored part.
